capabilities: play the Invaders shooter with keyboard controls
choose among sixteen one-player game variations
track a local high score and remembered setup
open the game library via ribbon icon or command
extras: Initial release is desktop-only and requires a physical keyboard and Obsidian 1.9.12+; no ROMs are included and the author states it is not affiliated with Atari or Taito.
motivation: The author was bored and wanted to learn by recreating the personality old games achieved with minimal hardware.
problem: Obsidian is a work tool with no built-in way to take a retro gaming break without leaving the app.
summary: Monochrome mini-game library for Obsidian featuring Invaders, an original Atari 2600-era inspired shooter with sixteen playable variations.
